note: Only 3 landmarks were supplied, and up to 6 non-landmark places are allowed, so this set has 9 places. It is below the 15 to 25 target. Add more landmarks to reach it. Prices are approximate USD. Check current prices and hours on the day.

siege.name: Gibraltar Great Siege Tunnels
siege.price_text: Approx. USD 15–25 adult · check on the day
siege.hours: Usually daily, mid-morning to late afternoon · check on the day
siege.tip: Wear comfortable shoes and a light jacket, since the tunnels stay cool and damp inside.
siege.best: Morning, before tour groups build up; any season

moorish.name: Moorish Castle
moorish.price_text: Check on the day · usually included in Upper Rock access fees
moorish.tip: Walk the ramparts for views over the town and the bay. Expect uneven stone steps.
moorish.best: Late afternoon for soft light; avoid hot midday in summer

casemates.name: Main Street & Casemates Square
casemates.hours: Open at all times; shops and cafés follow their own hours
casemates.tip: Stop at the square for cafés and street life, then browse the shops on Main Street.
casemates.best: Evening, when the square is busiest

upper.name: Upper Rock Nature Reserve
upper.price_text: Approx. USD 25–45 entry · check on the day
upper.hours: Check on the day; the reserve is closed in bad weather
upper.tip: Book the cable car or a taxi tour early, and bring water since there is little shade.
upper.best: Early morning in spring or autumn; cooler and clearer

cable.name: Gibraltar Cable Car
cable.price_text: Approx. USD 25–35 return · check on the day
cable.hours: Check on the day; times vary with weather
cable.tip: Ride up and walk down to see the Barbary macaques and the top viewpoints.
cable.best: Morning on a clear day for the best views

europa.name: Europa Point Lighthouse
europa.tip: Visit the lighthouse and mosque grounds, and look across the strait towards Africa.
europa.best: Sunset or on a clear day

catalan.name: Catalan Bay
catalan.hours: Open at all times; lifeguards in season only
catalan.tip: Head to the seafront cafés and fishing-village lanes for a relaxed local feel.
catalan.best: Warm months for swimming; any time for walking

ocean.name: Ocean Village
ocean.price_text: Varies · dining costs depend on the venue
ocean.hours: Restaurants usually open for lunch and dinner · check on the day
ocean.tip: Book a waterfront table in advance for evenings, especially at weekends.

museum.name: Gibraltar Museum
museum.price_text: Approx. USD 5–15 · check on the day
museum.tip: Start here to get the Gibraltar history background before you visit the tunnels and castle.
museum.best: Any time; good on a rainy day
